author: Mark Atwood
text:
Scope split per workspace canonical-template rule (AGENTS.md):

- onSuccessDestroyOriginal: implemented in this bead (mirrors canonical
  mail-server::handle_email_copy coverage).
- destroyFromIfInState: deferred to bd:JMAP-2svx (workspace-canonical
  fix on mail-server first, then propagate to all 7 extension-server
  siblings in one pass). Honoring it here in isolation would diverge
  from canonical and violate the propagation rule.

Implementation notes:
- handle_filenode_copy now takes a call_id: &str argument, mirroring
  handle_email_copy's signature. The implicit FileNode/set response
  carries the original client call_id per RFC 8620 §6.3.
- Honors the FileNode top-level onDestroyRemoveChildren flag for the
  implicit destroys (FileNode draft §3.2.4 'with the same behaviour'
  reads onto §3.2.3 nodeHasChildren semantics). This is filenode-
  specific behavior, not a canonical divergence — mail-server has
  no analogous flag because Emails are leaf objects.
